_comment: SFX library spec (audio agent). gen = seconds requested from eleven_text_to_sound_v2 (min 0.5); max = length kept after trimming; kind = expected acoustic profile checked by scripts/audio-tools.py sfx-check (noise: broadband, transient: short hit, tonal: pitched, low: bass-heavy); gate_db = onset threshold relative to the peak (lower keeps soft swells); fade = tail fade-out seconds.
palette: premium, clean, modern product-video sound palette: dry, close, no reverb wash, no cartoon, no retro game sounds

whoosh-fast.prompt: A very short, clean, airy whoosh for a fast UI swipe transition in a modern product video. Tight and crisp, no reverb tail.

whoosh-long.prompt: A smooth, clean, airy whoosh sweeping past the camera for a zoom-through transition in a modern product video. Soft swell up to a peak, then a short clean tail.

swoosh-up.prompt: A short rising swoosh, airy and bright, for a phone UI panel sliding up into view. Clean modern product sound, no reverb.

pop.prompt: A single short, bright, satisfying bubble pop for a chat message appearing. Clean, modern UI sound.

pop-soft.prompt: A single soft, gentle, muted bubble pop for a small chat bubble appearing. Subtle, warm, modern UI sound.

tap.prompt: A single soft fingertip tap on a glass phone screen. Subtle, clean, close, modern UI tap.
tap.regen_prompt: One single soft tap of a fingertip on a smartphone glass screen. Isolated, very short, clean and close. Only one tap, then silence.
tap.regen_reason: v1/v2: several quiet taps (peaks -26/-29 dBFS), not one tap

click.prompt: A single crisp, clean button click for a modern app interface. Short, precise, dry.
click.regen_prompt: One single crisp click of a phone app button, like a tight plastic tick. Isolated, very short, clean, one click then silence.
click.regen_reason: v1: 0.46 s of 14 kHz hiss with the peak at the end; v2: peak -46 dBFS over a noise floor

keypad.prompt: A single soft key tick on a phone number keypad. Very short, clean, subtle UI sound.

typing.prompt: Soft, quick typing on a phone touchscreen keyboard, a fast run of gentle taps for about one second. Clean and close, nothing else.

notif.prompt: A friendly, bright two-tone notification chime for a messaging app. Warm, modern, short and clean. An original sound, not any phone's default ringtone.

buzz.prompt: A single short phone vibration buzz on a wooden table. Clean, close, about a third of a second.

blips.prompt: Three soft rising digital blips in quick succession, like the typing dots pulsing in a chat app. Gentle, rounded, clean modern UI sound.
blips.regen_prompt: Three short, soft electronic blips, evenly spaced and rising in pitch, like three chat typing dots lighting up one after another. Rounded sine tones, gentle and clean, modern UI.
blips.regen_reason: v1: 8-10 kHz ticks; v2: one continuous warble, not three blips

success.prompt: A warm, bright, positive two-note chime for a payment approved in a modern fintech app. Rising interval, clean and short.
success.regen_prompt: A warm, bright two-note success chime: a short note followed by a higher note, a payment-approved sound in a modern fintech app. Soft bell tone, clean, short, positive.
success.regen_reason: v1/v2: a single pitch (581 / 1055 Hz), not two notes

burst.prompt: A sparkly pop with a quick airy whoosh, like confetti bursting out of a button. Celebratory but short and clean, modern UI.

riser.prompt: A two-second rising whoosh riser building tension into a drop. Clean, modern, airy noise with a soft synth swell, louder and higher until it stops at its peak.

impact.prompt: A deep, clean cinematic bass hit with a short tail for a logo reveal. Modern, warm sub boom, punchy, not distorted.
impact.regen_prompt: One single punchy cinematic impact for a logo reveal: a sharp hit with a deep sub-bass boom that decays smoothly within one second. Clean, modern, not distorted, no sustained drone.
impact.regen_reason: v1/v2: a sustained sub tone flat at full level for 1.0-1.3 s, not a hit

thud.prompt: A soft, solid thud of a card slamming down onto a table. Short, punchy, clean, no reverb.

scribble.prompt: One quick marker pen strike-through on paper, a single fast stroke. Close and clean.

paper.prompt: A short paper receipt being crumpled in one hand. Close, clean, about one second.

tick.prompt: A single crisp clock tick. Short, clean and dry, no reverb.

swipe.prompt: A quick, light UI swipe: a soft fast swish of a finger sliding across glass. Clean and short.

sparkle.prompt: A tiny, delicate shimmer: soft high chimes twinkling briefly. Clean, subtle UI highlight sound.

stamp.prompt: A soft, satisfying rubber stamp pressed onto paper: one short confirm thunk. Clean, no reverb.

glitch.prompt: A short digital glitch stutter: a crunchy, bit-crushed electronic blip. Quick and clean, for a tense error moment.
